title: Directions
description: A direction is a textual instruction attached to a point in the music, for anything that has no more specific representation. Directions belong to a part rather than to the score, and several may occur in the same measure. A direction carries no typography. How it is set is the renderer's decision, as it is for every other object in MNX. Proposed MNX objects, not yet adopted — see roadmap/proposed/score-text.md.
